text: Find a group of two black keys. C is the white key just to the left of it, D sits in the middle between the two black keys, and E is just to the right. The C in the middle of the piano is called Middle C.
Bass F is the F just below Middle C, on the fourth line of the bass staff. The bass clef's two dots sit either side of that line, so it's also called the F clef.
say_kokoro: [Bass](/bˈAs/) F is the F just below Middle C, on the fourth line of the [bass](/bˈAs/) staff. The [bass](/bˈAs/) clef's two dots sit either side of that line, so it's also called the F clef.
say_plain: Base F is the F just below Middle C, on the fourth line of the base staff. The base clef's two dots sit either side of that line, so it's also called the F clef.

text: Loud and soft make music more interesting. Forte means loud, and it's written f. Piano means soft, and it's written p.
p for soft and f for loud are dynamic marks. A new one sits between them: mf, mezzo forte, which means medium loud.
The two numbers at the start of the music are the time signature. 4/4 means there are 4 beats in every measure, and the quarter note gets one beat.
In 3/4 time there are three beats in each measure, with a strong first beat: ONE two three, ONE two three. The quarter note still gets one beat.
Allegro is an Italian word written at the start of a piece. It means fast and lively.
The white keys are named with the musical alphabet: just seven letters, A B C D E F G. After G it starts again with A, all the way up the keyboard.
say_kokoro: The white keys are named with the musical alphabet: just seven letters, [A](/ˈA/) B C D E F G. After G it starts again with A, all the way up the keyboard.
say_plain: The white keys are named with the musical alphabet: just seven letters, A, B, C, D, E, F, G. After G it starts again with A, all the way up the keyboard.

text: Let your arms hang down, heavy and loose, then float your hands up onto the keys. Curve your fingers as if your hand is holding a bubble: the fingertips stay firm and the thumb rests on its side tip.
Play C, D, E with right-hand fingers 2, 3, 4.
Left hand: E, D, C with fingers 2, 3, 4.
Which white key is just to the right of the two black keys?
